name: Heeding the Call
summary: A summons brings a novice druid to Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff for personal instruction. Word reaches aspiring shapeshifters through innkeepers and kin across Horde settlements, directing them to Turak Runetotem. There, the sacred trials begin, leading toward mastery of the bear's form and spirit.

sections.title: A Word in the Inn
sections.body: Across Mulgore and Orgrimmar, word reaches you that Turak Runetotem has noticed your early progress. Innkeeper Gryshka in Orgrimmar, Innkeeper Pala in Thunder Bluff, or Gennia Runetotem in Bloodhoof Village may carry the message. The Cenarion Circle does not summon practitioners lightly. Your work with herbs and simple spells has earned you a chance to deepen your bond with nature's wild spirits.

sections.title: The Circle on Elder Rise
sections.body: On Elder Rise, Turak Runetotem guides young tauren toward their ancestral duty. He assists Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem and welcomes you inside the large Cenarion tent. Turak teaches that animals and plants are allies, and solemn charges. Meeting him opens a path beyond basic instruction, toward trials of body and heart and communion with the Great Bear Spirit.

faq.q: Who sends me to speak with Turak Runetotem?
aliases: where do i start heeding the call
faq.answer: Gennia Runetotem in Bloodhoof Village, Innkeeper Pala in Thunder Bluff, or Innkeeper Gryshka in Orgrimmar may deliver the summons. Each has heard that Turak wishes to guide your training personally.

faq.q: Where can I find Turak Runetotem?
faq.answer: Turak Runetotem is inside the Cenarion Circle tent on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, near the city's other druidic mentors.

faq.q: Why is this summons so important for young druids?
faq.answer: The summons begins your formal shapeshifting trials. Turak directs you to sacred ground in Moonglade to learn the way of the bear and gain your first animal form.

faq.q: Who is Turak Runetotem in the Cenarion hierarchy?
faq.answer: Turak Runetotem is a respected tauren druid and a trusted assistant to Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem. He teaches young initiates about nature's balance with patience and wisdom.

faq.q: Can other classes accept this quest?
aliases: is heeding the call druid only
faq.answer: No. Only druids who have reached their tenth season of experience receive this summons, as a rite of passage into shapeshifting.

faq.q: What happens after I speak to Turak?
aliases: what comes after heeding the call
faq.answer: Turak welcomes you into Cenarius's service and sends you to Moonglade. There, you seek Dendrite Starblaze and begin communion with the Great Bear Spirit.

angles.text: As a druid, you begin the path to mastering animal forms and the sacred journey toward the bear's spirit and fortitude.
As a tauren, studying under Turak on Elder Rise renews your ancestral bond with the Cenarion Circle and Kalimdor's wild spirits.
As a member of the Horde, you hear the calling through innkeepers in orcish and tauren lands, sustaining your people's bond with the wild earth.
